source_text: **Example 9.5.2.** If $A$ is semisimple, each block is equivalent to the category of vector spaces (and thus has only one simple object). If $A$ is a commutative local artinian algebra, then there is only one block. Also there is just one block for the algebra of Problem 9.3.2.
